_comment: Snippets for the constructs that actually compile today — see the
'first milestone' section of docs/compiler.md. Nothing here expands to
syntax the compiler would reject: a snippet that produces a diagnostic
is worse than no snippet, and CONTRIBUTING.md's rule (never describe
behaviour that isn't implemented) applies to the editor as much as to
prose. So there is no snippet for a pointer — it parses, it does not
Keep in step with packages/compiler: a construct entering or leaving the
compiled subset belongs here too (see the repository's AGENTS.md).

Program with a frame loop.description: The shape of a program: set up once, then one pass per frame, forever.

Frame loop.description: while (true) { waitFrame(); ... } — the loop a program writes itself.

Countdown to a tick.description: Count frames down to a tick, then reload — the usual way to do something every N seconds.

Compile-time duration.description: #frames(n, seconds) — how many waitFrame() calls that much time takes, worked out at compile time.

Print a template.description: text.print(cell, `...`) — text and ${...} data fields, laid out at compile time.

Compile-time constant.description: A const: inlined wherever it is read, never stored on the machine.

Variable.description: A variable: a global at the top level, a local inside a function.

For loop.description: for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) — a counted loop with its own local.

Array in RAM.description: let name: array<T, N> — N values of T in RAM, zero until written; a[i] and a.length.

Data table.description: const NAME: array<T, N> = [...] — N values as data in the program, never in RAM; read with NAME[i].

Hardware register.description: @address — a name for a fixed memory location, not storage the compiler assigns.

Function.description: A function with scalar parameters and a return type.

Namespace.description: A namespace: compile-time qualification for a library surface, with no runtime cost.

Import a capability.description: Import a capability package; it resolves to whichever machine is being built.

Inline 6502 assembly.description: Raw 6502, passed through untouched — not available on the web target.

Poke a byte.description: memory.write — the low-level equivalent of POKE.

Peek a byte.description: memory.read — the low-level equivalent of PEEK.

Compile-time machine.description: #system() — the machine this build is for, worked out at compile time; compare with System.C64 and the other names from @8bitscript/system.
